title: Next.js 15+ (App Router)
summary: Next.js 15+, React 19, TypeScript (Strict), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Zod
rules: Default to React Server Components (RSC). Only mark leaf components with 'use client' when requiring state hooks, browser APIs, or interactivity.
Mutations must use Server Actions ('use server') in dedicated actions/ files, strictly validated with Zod schemas.
Route handlers in app/api/ are reserved for external webhooks or public APIs; internal UI data mutations use Server Actions.
Data fetching in RSCs should be direct async/await; never use client useEffect fetching.
Tailwind styling must use cn() helper and follow Radix/shadcn accessibility standards.
